legacyLocalFixtureCompatibility.manifestCanonicalization: UTF-8 JSON; recursively sorted object keys; array order retained; no whitespace; SHA-256
legacyLocalFixtureCompatibility.resolvedLineageCanonicalization: SHA-256 of leaf-first identity:rawFileSha256 lines joined by LF with no trailing LF

digestCanonicalization.fixtureFileSha256: SHA-256 of the exact fixture file bytes at sourceCommit
digestCanonicalization.registrationFileSha256: SHA-256 of the exact registration file bytes at sourceCommit
digestCanonicalization.categoryAndToolSetSha256: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON of categoryAndToolSet with recursively sorted object keys, array order retained, no whitespace
digestCanonicalization.identityMapSha256: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON of the fixture entry capture identityMap array with recursively sorted object keys, array order retained, no whitespace
digestCanonicalization.caseInputSha256: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON of the editorial case file input member with recursively sorted object keys, array order retained, no whitespace
digestCanonicalization.allFixtureFileInventorySha256: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON of allFixtureFileInventory with recursively sorted object keys, array order retained, no whitespace

registeredPurposeBasis.journey: every e2e --j04-model-adapter launch selection at sourceCommit; complete for J-04, J-07, J-09, J-10, J-11, J-13 and J-16
registeredPurposeBasis.registeredEditorialEvidenceCase: exactly the five deterministic cases in registeredEvidenceCases
registeredPurposeBasis.registeredServiceTest: documentary fixture-identity references found at sourceCommit; not exhaustive, not scope-filtered and not a runtime match key
registeredPurposeBasis.selectionUnchangedCheck: registration file bytes identical at exactFixedMetadataUnchangedAtPreparationBase, or no line added or removed between sourceCommit and that base names a fixture identity, a fixture constant, loadModelFixture, loadLaunchFixture or --j04-model-adapter

matchSemantics.codeFilePins: sourceCommit provenance verified unchanged at exactFixedMetadataUnchangedAtPreparationBase; not a runtime match precondition
runtimeMatchKeys: exact executable task kind or session purpose
exact fixture identity, fixture file SHA-256, ordered lineage and resolved lineage SHA-256
exact entry key unitOrdinal, requestDigest and attempt-or-null under fixtureResolverSemantics
per-Run frozen prompt-contract, composition, source, category/tool and message digests
existing restrictions objects and fixtureResolverSemantics Journey limits
final payload Egress Gate and current binding, source and exclusion standing
matchSemantics.registeredPurposes: provenance; runtime purpose enforcement is limited to the existing restrictions objects, fixtureResolverSemantics and the registered evidence cases existing routes; no new purpose restriction and no purpose-based widening
matchSemantics.currentCodeRevalidation: the selecting activation child and any landing base re-verify current semantics at that exact base by replaying the affected Journey matrix and registered evidence routes; a changed request digest, contract, composition or entry key yields the existing disclosed refusal

legacyLocalFixtureCompatibility.newLaunchPlans: v29 with exact legacy profile/manifest pin; preserve historical request construction and request keys
legacyLocalFixtureCompatibility.persistedV1Plans: remain v1; historical compatibility path; never silently relabel or rewrite
